findings.title: Moral content as inwardly taken in

findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the pair as an interiorly received capacity, not only as information announced to the soul.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains that the soul is inspired with its fujur and taqwa. The whole-intake image is a qualified resonance and does not assert a physiological or exhaustive theory of inspiration.

epistemic.reason: The cross-run support is trusted and focus-anchored, while the wider connection supplies target Arabic without target morphology and therefore qualifies the inferred contact.
